title: ALL CONQUERING MASTER AND SAVIOUR BY VASHUAN AND

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Up from the tomb, Lord, You rose
For death and hell could not hold You down
Now, You sit on the throne far above
All kingdoms, rulers and governments

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: With a title beyond every rank
You reign without an end
All authority Lord, You command
You are the greatest King over all

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Blessed Christ, Lord Jesus
You’re the all-conquering Master and Saviour
Immeasurably great is the power of Your name
In heaven, on earth, and beneath

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: You are the life, source of creation
You’re the One who governs every nation
Forever You reign, in an endless domain
Your glory covers the earth
